$comment: Phase 2A.5 (entity types, Task 17): the generic lifecycle of a maestro or documento, Imprimir and Notificar. Aprobar and Anular are writes: the assistant answers with a confirmation card and runs nothing before the accept (rule 17); Notificar sends a message out of the system, so it is a write too; Imprimir is a consult. A document the caller cannot modify is refused before any card (typed-confirm.integration.test.ts).
